What we're looking for

Mayari runs on players who show up. Here's what we expect in return for the content, training, and gear.

  • Active players
  • Players looking to improve
  • PvP players must be able to VOD review fights
  • No fame requirement!

Weekly activity requirement

There are no longer separate mandatory PvE/PvP attendance requirements. Instead, every member must earn 7 Attendance Points per week.
